Chapter 19

Chapter 19: Exciting! 51% of Yinshan Group’s Shares

Under everyone’s gaze, Lin Tao was pushed into the operating room.

Originally, Zhao Jiaqi wanted to leave after Lin Tao’s surgery.

However, as the leader of Qing City, he had too many things to deal with.

Zhao Jiaqi had to leave the hospital in advance after receiving an emergency call.

Time passed by.

In the blink of an eye, it was 12 o’clock.

Lin Fan’s phone vibrated. A red packet had appeared.

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 2,000 yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received five yuan.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 10,000 yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained 51% of Yinshan Group’s shares.]

When Lin Fan received the red packet, he paused for a moment.

Yinshan group?

If he remembered correctly, Yinshan Group’s subsidiary companies included Yinshan Shopping Center, Yinshan Gold, and other companies. Their market value was definitely above ten billion.

He now owned 51% of Yinshan Group’s shares?

Would that not mean that he would instantly gain billions in assets?

It was this moment of daze that made the time reach 12:01 p.m.

However, Lin Fan did not feel that it was a pity.

With this 51% of shares, getting fewer red packets meant nothing.

Creak! Creak!

At this moment, the door of the operating room slowly opened.

Li Quan and a few doctors dragged their tired bodies out.

“Director Li, how’s Lin Tao?” Dai Weixue asked nervously.

“The surgery was very successful. He should be fine after staying in the hospital for a while,” Li Quan said.

“Alright, thank you. Thank you so much.” Dai Weixue was extremely excited.

Even though she already knew that Li Quan was an expert with high medical skills and could treat Lin Tao, Dai Weixue’s heart was still hanging in the air during this time.

She was not able to sleep at all last night

After all, there were risks and accidents in any surgery.

It was only now that her heart settled down.

“Can I go and see Lin Tao?” Dai Weixue asked.

“Mr. Lin just finished his surgery,” Li Quan said. “He’s asleep now. It’s best to let him rest for a while.”

“Alright, alright,” Dai Weixue responded.

When Lin Tao opened his eyes, it was already night.

“Dad, you’re awake!” After school, Lin Xiaoyao, who had rushed straight to the hospital, called out happily.

“Xiaoyao, lower your voice!” Dai Weixue chided in a low voice.

“Lin Tao, do you feel uncomfortable anywhere?” she asked softly.

“Dad, how do you feel?” Lin Fan asked.

“I’m feeling pretty good.” Lin Tao shook his head.

When they heard this, they were all even happier.

…

On the other hand, in the chairman’s office of Yinshan Group.

Song Zhifeng read the information in front of him several times and sighed. “In the beginning, for the sake of development, a large number of shares flowed into the market.

“And now, this Mr. Lin Fan has actually acquired 51% of Yinshan Group’s shares!”

Song Zhifeng’s face was filled with regret as he said this.

With 51% of the shares, he was undoubtedly the largest shareholder!

Yinshan group was a business empire that Song Zhifeng had established. Now, it was no longer under his control.

How could he not regret it?

Song Zhifeng hesitated for a long time before he finally dialed the number on the information.

“Hello, Mr. Lin. I’m Song Zhifeng, the chairman of Yinshan Group,” Song Zhifeng said carefully.

Lin Fan’s deep voice came from the phone, “Oh, what’s the matter?”

Lin Fan quickly thought of the 51% shares he had obtained from Yinshan Group in the afternoon. Hence, he was not too surprised when Song Zhifeng called.

“You’re the biggest shareholder of Yinshan Group. Do you have any instructions for the group’s future development?” Song Zhifeng asked.

“Just do as you did in the past,” Lin Fan said. “Develop well. I’ll only hold the company’s shares.”

Lin Fan had no interest in the development of Yinshan Group.

If he could, he wanted to sell all his shares immediately.

Unfortunately, all the items he obtained from the system were prohibited from being traded.

Song Zhifeng’s face lit up with joy. “Alright, we’ll definitely transfer the dividends to your account on time.”

Song Zhifeng was very afraid that the company’s largest shareholder would command the company at will. If he only wanted to get dividends, it would definitely be good news for him-extremely good news!

…

In the next few days, Lin Fan stayed in the hospital to take care of Lin Tao. He also had the doctor use the best medicine to help Lin Tao’s body recover.

Just the cost of nursing alone would cost tens of thousands of yuan a day.

Lin Tao’s health and complexion were getting better day by day. He could even get out of bed and walk.

For the past few days, Lin Fan only received cash from the red packets that appeared at noon.

On top of that, he also received the cash earned from breathing, walking, and sleeping.

Lin Fan’s account balance had an additional three million.

[Name: Lin Fan]

[Level: LV4]

[Level 4 reward: ten yuan for every breath; ten yuan for every second of sleep; ten yuan for every step taken. Rewards are distributed at 12 a.m. daily.]

[Upgrade cost: 750000/10 million (not including gifts and gambling. In addition, all items obtained from the system are prohibited from being traded.]

[Skills: Professional Driving Skills, Charming Aura (5% chance to trigger love at first sight and unforgettable love), Violent Aesthetics, Drinking Gentleman, Absolute Focus (5% chance to trigger a flash of inspiration), Professor-Level Mathematics Experience.]

[Funds: 10.3 million.]

It was obvious that the five million that Lin fan had transferred to Dai Weixue a few days ago had not been included in his budgeting.

However, Lin Fan did not mind at all.

Dai Weixue peeled an apple for Lin Tao and said, “It’s the weekend today, and it’s rare for Lil’ Yao to have some rest time. Lil’ Fan, take Lil’ Yao out to play.”

“Yeah, you guys should go out and play. My body is fine now. You guys are making the ward stuffy,” Lin Tao said.

Lin Fan felt that his father’s words made sense.

“Then let’s go out for a walk.” He nodded.

“Alright!” Lin Xiaoyao said happily.

When she knew her father had fallen sick, Lin Xiaoyao was very sad and scared.

Now, her father was fine.

Lin Xiaoyao, who was naturally active, felt a little uncomfortable staying in the ward.

Lin Fan looked at Lin Xiaoyao’s slightly dull clothes and said, “Lil’ Yao, let’s go buy some clothes first. Which mall is the best in Qing City? Don’t try to save money for me.”

“Yinshan Mall!” Lin Xiaoyao said happily.

In the past, Lin Xiaoyao would never have gone to Yinshan Mall to buy clothes.

The clothes there were indeed beautiful, but they were also relatively expensive.

Now, Lin Xiaoyao did not have so many concerns.

After all, Lin Fan was driving a sports car that was worth millions.

Lin Xiaoyao did not feel any burden at all by the idea of using Lin Fan’s money to buy a few expensive clothes.

As an older brother, should he not be spending money on his younger sister?

Moreover, Lin Fan had also told her not to hesitate.

When Lin Fan heard Lin Xiaoyao’s words, he gave her a weird look.

Yinshan Mall?

Strictly speaking, this seemed to be his own business.

‘Going to my own mall to buy clothes?’

“Alright, let’s go to Yinshan Mall.” Lin fan smiled.
